context: An elderly couple looks back on raising the kids separately at one point
purpose: Teach: やむを得ない/何もかも/無理やり/うれしかっ/別々/つなぎ/余分/気付き

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔、転勤で家族別々に暮らした時期があったな。
lines.en: There was a time years ago when work transfers kept our family living apart.
lines.style: Quiet opening, as if retrieving an old memory. Measured pace. Slight weight on 「昔」. No rush—letting the thought settle. Gentle, almost wistful.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: やむを得ない事情だったわね。何もかも子供たちに我慢させてしまった。
lines.en: It was circumstances beyond our control. We made the children bear so much.
lines.style: Soft but carrying a thread of old regret. Not self-flagellating—just honest about the cost. Voice steady, eyes distant. Slight pause before the second sentence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 無理やり呼び寄せるわけにもいかなかった。
lines.en: Couldn't have forced them to come with me either.
lines.style: Measured, almost matter-of-fact. A factual acceptance rather than defensiveness. Grounded tone. The sadness is in what's unsaid, not in how it's spoken.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 長期休みは、つなぎの時間として、皆で過ごせてうれしかったわね。
lines.en: But during the long holidays, those times together felt like the real thread holding us. We were happy.
lines.style: Brightens slightly. Genuine warmth enters. Voice softens on memories of togetherness. Deliberate—savoring those moments. Cadence slows on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 余分なお小遣いを忍ばせて、子供たちは気付きを得てくれた。
lines.en: I'd slip them extra spending money, and they understood without me having to say it.
lines.style: Tender, almost secretive—a small kindness remembered. Wry half-smile in the voice. Intimate, like sharing something precious. Pace is gentle and deliberate.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 今思うと、それも教育だったわね。
lines.en: When I think about it now, that was a kind of teaching too.
lines.style: Soft, reflective conclusion. Slight wonder in the tone—a recognition earned through time. Exhale at the end. Quiet wisdom settling like evening light.
